CharacterDialogue.Text: (Finally,^2 my first day at the Digital Media Lab.^1 They say only the bravest of all can participate in an experiment like this...)
(I hope I am prepared enough.^1 This is so exciting!)
Ah, there you are!^1 Took you long enough!
Well,^2 the Deutsche Bahn kind of doesn't expect snow in winter,^2 so the trains were late by merely...^1 120 minutes.
We have no time for any chit-chat.^1 They have received the order.^1 Now,^2 we need to act and we act fast.
Okay,^2 what is it that I should do?^2 You were so secretive in the flyer.
Secretive indeed.^1 It's a secret objective concerning a restaurant:^1 "The Orange Kitten".
Ohhh,^2 I've heard about it.^1 They make very delicious food!^1 I heard a cat walks around there?
Precisely.^1 We'd like to establish our own restaurant chain,^2 but to do so,^2 we'd like to figure out how they make those recipes.
That's why we need your service today.^1 Are you willing to take on this task?
Yes,^2 throw it at me.^1 What do I need to do?
